t: A big Arduino board with a Linux AI computer and a real-time microcontroller.
steps: Buy the board from the Arduino Store USA, Micro Center or Mouser. The retail price is 399 US dollars.
Get a 5 V 3 A USB-C supply or a 12 to 24 V barrel jack supply.
Connect a screen and keyboard, or plug the board into your computer with USB-C.
Open Arduino App Lab, which runs on the board or from your computer.
Run a sketch that scrolls text across the LED grid.
Try an example that pairs a Python script with a sketch.
Add a camera and try an object detection example next.
meta: Open Board. From $306. A few stores.
